title: Marines Complete Arrested Landings on Tinian
description: Marine Wing Support Squadron-171 conducted an arrestment landing exercise using two M-31 Marine Corps expeditionary arresting gear systems Dec. 5 at Tinian’s West Field during Exercise Forager Fury II. Includes sound bites from CWO2 Charles Dine, Expeditionary Airfield Fire and Emergency Services Officer,Marine Wing Support Squadron 171 and Cpl. Benjamin Romulus, Aviation Supply Clerk, MWSS 171. (U.S. Navy video by Petty Officer 3rd Class D'artanyan Ratley)
